programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: Brandon dares Kayne to locate a honey ant in the heart of the central desert, setting him up for a nearly impossible task. The challenge becomes even more absurd when Kayne discovers that these elusive ants live about four feet underground, turning what seemed like a simple scavenger hunt into a comically daunting—and slightly hopeless—adventure.

programs.title: Motown Magic
programs.sub_title: Runaway Child, Running Child And Don't Mess With Bill
programs.desc: Imaginative boy Ben transforms his city by bringing colourful street art to life, armed with a magic paintbrush and the classic sounds of Motown.

programs.title: The Magic Canoe
programs.desc: Julie walks away from the camp without saying where she is going. The other travelers are worried and Max warns her not to go any further. The canoe adventure takes the travelers to the far north.

programs.title: Spartakus And The Sun Beneath The Sea
programs.desc: The heroes meet Tutankhaton, young heir to the throne of Egypt, who will soon become Pharaoh.

programs.title: The World According To Grandpa
programs.desc: Connie asks how electricity is made, prompting Grandpa to spin one of his tall tales about an inventor named Rabinder. Don Warrington stars.

programs.title: Chums
programs.desc: A piece of meat goes missing from the Village where Cota Coyote and Red Fox are suspects. The Chums help Elder Kohkum find out who did it.
